initial:
Use case: style-transfer / background-extraction.
Asset type: a single custom-painted graffiti grade glyph for an offline poster renderer, intended to fit approximately a 640 × 600 display area.
Input image 1 is a STYLE AND LETTERFORM REFERENCE. Focus on its enormous central cyan A and minus sign. Re-create ONLY that A− as an isolated, genuinely transparent RGBA asset. Do not include anything else from the poster.

Text (verbatim): "A−". Exactly one uppercase Latin A and one separate horizontal minus sign to its upper-middle right, all legible together.
Make the A giant, highly expressive, unmistakably HAND-PAINTED with a wide loaded street brush: dramatic fast forward-slung perspective, broad powerful strokes with very strong thickness variation, long tapered downward-left drag tails, ripped irregular bristle edges, large directional dry-brush voids through the pigment, scraped-through gaps and broken paint. Its left diagonal sweeps long toward lower left, right leg is shorter, crossbar bursts right with a sharp taper. Retain the reference's aggressive narrow triangular counter and dynamic ascending crossbar. Make the minus a broad fast cyan swipe, rising subtly right, with pointed ends and dry brush breaks. A dominant bright electric cyan/turquoise (#00EAD9 to #00F8EA); sparse thin white raw brush-edge accents, at most 5% of the painted area. Neither a white glow nor a solid white or black border.
The actual stroke silhouettes and large transparent gaps must create the brush character; do not make a tidy geometric italic letter with a few fine cracks added. It must feel painted in several forceful, imperfect brush gestures, not a font or vector logo. Modest nearby cyan paint flecks may accompany stroke terminals, but no independent decorative symbols.
Composition: roughly square canvas, the complete A− group occupies most of the canvas with a safe 6% transparent margin on ALL sides. All tails and flecks entirely inside the canvas.
Background MUST be truly transparent, including interior holes and dry-brush missing-paint voids. No black backing, no white backing, no checkerboard pixels, no background scene, no cast shadow.
Exclude every crown, arrow, date, statistic, Chinese character, word, underline or graphic other than the single A and minus sign. No even outline, no uniform black contour, no comic-book stroke, no bevel, no 3D extrusion, no neon bloom.
revision:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit this existing transparent cyan graffiti A− asset. Preserve the same brush-painted A silhouette, asymmetric tapering long leg, sharp triangular counter, electric turquoise pigment, torn bristle edges, dry brushed missing-paint texture, and sparse white accents. Keep its current confident aggressive forward-slanted feel.
Correct ONLY these framing and legibility defects:
1. Separate the minus sign from the A. The minus must float independently to the RIGHT of the A with an unmistakable transparent gap at least the width of the A's right leg. It must not connect to the crossbar or become an extension of it. Make the minus a short thick separate horizontal/slightly rising cyan brushstroke with tapered torn ends. The exact text remains "A−".
2. Fit ALL painted strokes and flecks fully inside the transparent canvas with an 8% clear transparent margin on ALL FOUR sides. In particular, completely preserve the very long lower-left brush taper rather than cutting it at the bottom border. The complete artwork must occupy only the central 84% of canvas width and height.
3. Keep the black-looking areas fully transparent as in the input. Do not fill them. Maintain real RGBA alpha, including counter and brush holes. No background, no outline, no glow, no shadow, no additional text or icon, no crown, no arrow. Cyan and sparse white paint only.
Keep the asset organic and irregular, not a font or a tidy geometric comic-book glyph.
optionalTextureExperiment:
Use case: style-transfer.
Repaint the provided A− cutout as a vigorous REAL DRY-BRUSH GRAFFITI HAND LETTERING asset. Exact text "A−" only, on a genuine transparent RGBA background.

Preserve the letter structure, elongated left diagonal, aggressive ascending perspective, separate short minus on the right, bright electric cyan color, sparse white edge accents, and readable triangular inner counter. Preserve the obvious transparent gap between A and minus.
TARGETED TEXTURE IMPROVEMENT: replace the current foamy granular perimeter and solid filled interior with rough, sharply shredded, directional BRISTLE MARKS. A nearly dry huge flat paintbrush was dragged hard over a rough surface; many long jagged transparent streaks and several large wedge-shaped missing-paint slivers should cut THROUGH the cyan stroke interiors along the direction of the brush. The thick cyan strokes must still read boldly and continuously, but about 15% of the body pigment has clear ripped transparent dry-brush voids. Large directional breaks, not little random hairline scratches. Stroke ends split into 3-6 long uneven pointed bristles. Keep organic loaded-paint variation. No rounded bubbly foam outline, no uniform vector edge, no shadow, no black line or black backing, no glow.
FRAMING: scale the entire complete painted mark down enough that the outermost tails sit comfortably within an 8% transparent safety margin on all four sides. A nearly square canvas. Absolutely no cropped tails. Cyan, tiny white edge strokes, and transparency only.
No crown, arrow, underline, extra symbols, caption, scene or other lettering.
